verdict.rationale: Vestd documents its own building blocks for this story: board-ready equity governance with deed/witness signatures and custom document templates (vestd-docs-18, vestd-docs-30). It also offers digital share authorisation with "no paperwork" (vestd-docs-8, vestd-docs-11) and data rooms for storing documents (vestd-docs-4). However, nothing shows board consents or shareholder resolutions specifically being drafted, routed for e-signature, and archived against the share issuance they authorise. Missing for 10: explicit board-consent and shareholder-resolution drafting workflows, documented e-signature routing to directors and shareholders, linkage of approvals to the specific transactions they authorise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
